modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Air Vanuatu's conditions of carriage list a cabin baggage allowance for domestic flights only.

carryon_weight.value: Vanuatu domestic flights, Economy: 5kg of cabin baggage. No size limit is stated in the conditions of carriage.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Air Vanuatu's conditions of carriage list a checked allowance for domestic flights only; baggage fees are non-refundable.

allowance_domestic.value: Vanuatu domestic flights: 10kg for an adult, 10kg for a child, no allowance (0) for an infant.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Missing the check-in close-off time means you are denied boarding and must buy a new ticket.

domestic_cutoff.value: Vanuatu domestic flights: check-in opens 2 Hours before departure and closes 45 Minutes before.

phone_home_market.notes: Given as Air Vanuatu's phone number in Vanuatu in its conditions of carriage.
